subject: Purchase order requirements, issuance timeline, and line-item format – kickoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearwaterlabs.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase order requirements, issuance timeline, and line-item format – kickoff

Tom / Clearwater team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference deployment — excited to get procurement moving so we can align billing and deployment timing. To keep the kickoff focused, a few specific asks from our side so Procurement + Vendor Ops have everything needed for PO issuance: 

- PO requirements: confirm legal name for invoicing, W-9 or equivalent (US), tax ID, remit-to address, and PO routing email (who should receive invoices). 
- PO timing: please confirm your standard lead time for processing a PO once an order is approved; we typically need the vendor to accept a PO within 5 business days to meet our internal timelines.
- Line-item structure: Redwood prefers line-items split by SKU, description, quantity, unit price, and an ancillary field for billing code. If you have an internal PO template, please share; else, we attached a sample CSV for quick mapping.

Attachments: we will send a vendor intake form and a sample PO line-item CSV in follow-up (permission to share our template if helpful).

Next steps: could you confirm the three items above by end of day Wednesday (14 Apr)? Once we have remit details and a sample template, Connor will draft the PO for your review.

Appreciate it — short and actionable so we can meet the deployment window.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
[Attachment: none in this message]
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearwaterlabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <vendor-admin@clearwaterlabs.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order requirements, issuance timeline, and line-item format – kickoff

Vanessa,

Thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below: 

- Legal invoicing name: Clearwater Laboratories, Inc.
- Tax docs: W-9 attached (PDF) — procurement@clearwaterlabs.com is our finance inbox for PO routing.
- Remit-to: 412 Harbor St, Suite 200, San Diego, CA 92101
- PO processing lead time: we typically issue an acknowledgement within 2 business days and generate an invoice within 7 business days of PO acceptance. If any legal redlines are needed that can add time.
- Line-item format: we can accept line-items in CSV or via a brief template. Our preferred fields are: SKU | Description | Qty | Unit Price | GL Code. I reviewed your sample in the Drive link and the fields map well.

I attached our standard vendor onboarding checklist and a signed vendor agreement (PDF) for your records. We will review Connor's draft PO once it lands.

Tom Reynolds
Procurement Lead
Clearwater Labs
tom.reynolds@clearwaterlabs.com
[Attachments: clearwater_w9.pdf, clearwater_vendor_checklist.pdf]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearwaterlabs.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order requirements, issuance timeline, and line-item format – kickoff

Tom — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups so we can produce a PO that matches your finance expectations: 

- Can you confirm whether Clearwater requires a separate line for any one-time onboarding/setup fees vs recurring usage commitments? We usually separate those to avoid billing confusion.
- For GL Code: if you do not require a code, we will leave that blank and include our internal billing tag in the PO notes.

I'm attaching two files for your team to review and map to your system:
- vendor_intake_form.xlsx (fillable) — includes remit, tax, and payment terms fields we need in our vendor record.
- sample_po_lineitems.csv — a minimal example we use when issuing POs for Dedicated capacity (includes SKU/desc/qty/unit/notes).

Please return the intake form completed and indicate whether onboarding fees should be separate line-items. If everything looks good we'll route the draft PO to procurement@clearwaterlabs.com; based on your timing note we expect acceptance/ack within 2 business days and invoice generation within 7 days.

Thanks — Connor will run the draft PO and ping if any field mapping issues pop up.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
[Attachments: vendor_intake_form.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample_po_lineitems.csv (CSV)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order requirements, issuance timeline, and line-item format – kickoff

Quick internal note: I reviewed the Clearwater responses and the intake form you attached. Approval to proceed. Two small asks for Connor/Dev before PO send:

1) Add a one-line note in the PO body: "Pricing subject to Redwood Dedicated SOW v1.0; see contract #RDW-4721" so Procurement has a linkage.
2) If onboarding/setup fees are included, list them as separate fixed-price line-items with "One-time" in the notes field.

Once Connor confirms mapping to their GL Code field (or leaves blank), Vanessa, please send the draft PO to procurement@clearwaterlabs.com.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
